This has not the first time that PNT+ has been useful, but it is fantastic to have a version of the prime number theorem available in order to formalise the proof irrationality of ζ(5):

https://github.com/mo271/zeta5

Thanks everybody!
Since I wanted to have a version that compiles in Formal Conjectures (FC#6517), I bumped the lean version of PNT+ on the way https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/pull/1779
Do you think that we are getting some new insights out of this proof?
The real question: When are we going to get a proof that docs#riemannZeta_one is irrational? :slight_smile:

In all seriousness though, Persiflage has a blog post trying to understand what's going on: https://galoisrepresentations.org/2026/09/24/zeta5-is-irrational/ (it also references the Lean formalization!)
